import html from typing import List # Example template – in real usage this should be defined elsewhere and imported. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

By: {writer_name}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(writer_name: str, title: str, body: str, tag_list: List[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- writer_name : str Name of the author. title : str Post headline. body : str Main content of the post. tag_list : list[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str Escaped HTML string suitable for rendering in a web page. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to prevent XSS safe_writer = html.escape(writer_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Build tag spans – each tag is escaped individually safe_tags = " ".join(f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_list) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( writer_name=safe_writer, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags )
